Brazilian public expenditure on education

Source: R/get_expenditure.R
get_expenditure.Rd

Returns the harmonised series of public expenditure on education, compiled by Kang & Menetrier (2024) from the long-run Brazilian national accounts and educational statistics. Three indicator families are exposed:

Usage

get_expenditure(
  level = NULL,
  indicator = NULL,
  year = NULL,
  source = NULL,
  wide = FALSE,
  lang = c("en", "pt")
)

Arguments

level

Character vector of stage codes: "fundamental_anos_iniciais", "fundamental_anos_finais", "fundamental", "medio", "fundamental_medio", "superior", "total". The two "double ratio" indicators are tagged with level = "total". NULL (default) means no filter.

indicator

Character vector. Convenience aliases are accepted: "share_gdp", "per_student", "double_ratio_es_ef1", "double_ratio_es_ef_em". Full indicator keys ("expenditure_share_gdp", etc.) also work. NULL (default) returns all four indicators.

year

Integer vector or two-element c(min, max) range. NULL for all years.

source

Character vector of source keys. NULL returns all available sources (currently only "kang_menetrier_2024").

wide

Logical. If TRUE, pivots the result to wide form (one column per indicator). Default FALSE.

lang

One of "en" (default) or "pt". When "pt", factor levels and indicator labels are translated via inst/dict/i18n.yaml.

Value

A tibble in the canonical educabr2 long schema (see inst/dict/schema.yaml). Columns: year, geo_level, geo_code, geo_name, level, network, dim_race, age_group, indicator, value, unit, source, source_note. network is always "publica" (public-sector expenditure only).

Details

  • expenditure_share_gdp — total public expenditure on a given stage, as share of GDP.

  • expenditure_per_student_pct_gdp_pc — per-student public expenditure in the public network, expressed as share of GDP per capita (a unit-free, cross-country-comparable measure).

  • expenditure_double_ratio_es_ef1 and expenditure_double_ratio_es_ef_em — Kang & Menetrier's "double ratio" indicators of fiscal regressivity (per-student spending on tertiary divided by per-student spending on, respectively, EF1 and EF+EM combined).

All series are national (BR), 1933-2010. The data behind this function is the internal dataset expenditure_kang_fgv.

Português

Consulta a despesa pública em educação compilada por Kang & Menetrier (2024), Brasil, 1933–2010. Os indicadores incluem participação no PIB, gasto por estudante em % do PIB per capita e razões duplas de regressividade.

  • level: vetor de etapas; inclui total, fundamental, anos iniciais e finais, medio, fundamental_medio e superior.

  • indicator: aceita "share_gdp", "per_student", "double_ratio_es_ef1", "double_ratio_es_ef_em" ou chaves completas.

  • year: anos ou intervalo c(inicio, fim); NULL inclui todos.

  • source: chaves de fonte; NULL inclui todas.

  • wide: FALSE por padrão; TRUE cria uma coluna por indicador.

  • lang: "en" (padrão) ou "pt" (rótulos traduzidos).

Filtros NULL não restringem os dados. Retorna tibble no esquema canônico, com valor, unidade e proveniência. Os dados são nacionais; esta função não recebe filtros geográficos nem argumento dimension.

Examples

# Total public expenditure on education as share of GDP
get_expenditure(indicator = "share_gdp", level = "total")
#> # A tibble: 78 × 13
#>     year geo_level geo_code geo_name level network dim_race age_group indicator 
#>    <int> <chr>     <chr>    <chr>    <chr> <chr>   <chr>    <chr>     <chr>     
#>  1  1933 BR        BR       Brasil   total publica total    NA        expenditu…
#>  2  1934 BR        BR       Brasil   total publica total    NA        expenditu…
#>  3  1935 BR        BR       Brasil   total publica total    NA        expenditu…
#>  4  1936 BR        BR       Brasil   total publica total    NA        expenditu…
#>  5  1937 BR        BR       Brasil   total publica total    NA        expenditu…
#>  6  1938 BR        BR       Brasil   total publica total    NA        expenditu…
#>  7  1939 BR        BR       Brasil   total publica total    NA        expenditu…
#>  8  1940 BR        BR       Brasil   total publica total    NA        expenditu…
#>  9  1941 BR        BR       Brasil   total publica total    NA        expenditu…
#> 10  1942 BR        BR       Brasil   total publica total    NA        expenditu…
#> # ℹ 68 more rows
#> # ℹ 4 more variables: value <dbl>, unit <chr>, source <chr>, source_note <chr>

# Per-student spending in tertiary education over time
get_expenditure(indicator = "per_student", level = "superior")
